name: Uchiyama Atsushi
source:
A friend of Makoto's who moved into the house next door.

He told Makoto about his physical relationship with his mother as if it were a matter of course. A boy with excellent grades and a good-natured personality.

From [url=http://www.complets.co.jp/complet's/mamatuma.htmll]official site[/url].
